group_results.reason: Parsed strings and object keys reach cJSON_Delete on success or parser cleanup. The added assignments follow deallocation and do not alter the deletion contract.
Quoted input reaches parse_string. An invalid escape after allocation reaches the changed cleanup, and parse failure returns safely to the entry.
Both unbuffered printing calls reach print. The default realloc hook selects the changed reallocation branch; its pointer reset precedes return of the printed buffer.

The added copy-branch reset requires a null realloc hook, while this target uses the non-null default. The added fail-branch reset only clears a local pointer after deallocation, immediately before returning NULL.
The buffered option calls cJSON_PrintBuffered with prebuffer 1 and either format setting. Its failure path returns NULL, which the entry accepts; the added assignment does not change that result.
The complete entry never calls cJSON_free. Its print-result free matches the library’s default deallocator, and cJSON_free’s added assignment only changes its local parameter after deallocation.

build.reason: The delegated script configures a static cJSON build, builds it, and links cjson_read_fuzzer.c with the fuzzing engine and static library. The CMake defaults and library declaration support that route; this assesses the recipe, not an observed build result.

input.reason: The entry requires four binary option bytes and a final NUL, then passes the suffix to the C-string parser. The parser derives its length from strlen and handles invalid JSON by returning NULL.

lifecycle.reason: The entry frees non-null print results and deletes successful parse trees. Default library allocation and deallocation use malloc and free; the optional copied buffer is also freed on its normal route.

control_flow.reason: After its guards, the entry parses, selects buffered or formatted/unformatted printing, optionally minifies a copy, and deletes the parsed tree. The source dispatch and default hooks establish the changed routes and the unreachable copy branch.
